meta.title: Viktoria Chernobay — interior and real estate photographer, Warsaw | Black Bay Studio
meta.description: Real estate photography studio in Warsaw. Interior, architecture and drone photography for agencies, developers and designers. Finished photos in 48–72 hours.

hero.title: Interiors that sell faster.
hero.subtitle: A real estate and architecture photography studio in Warsaw. We photograph apartments, houses and commercial spaces for agencies, developers and interior designers.

intro.statement: From session to finished photos in 48–72 hours. Viktoria Chernobay leads every shoot, our post-production team handles the editing, and a licensed drone operator takes the aerial shots.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Everything a listing or a portfolio needs, in one booking.
services.interiors_desc: Apartments, houses and venues in natural light. Straight verticals, true colours, nothing distorted.
services.architecture_desc: Buildings, facades and whole properties for developers and architecture firms.
services.drone_desc: Houses and plots from above, showing the surroundings, access and scale of the property.
services.reels_desc: Short vertical videos of the property for Instagram, TikTok and listings.
services.retouch_desc: HDR and colour correction as standard. On request: recolouring furniture, removing or adding objects.

portfolio.title: Work
portfolio.subtitle: Selected sessions from Warsaw and the surrounding area. Click a project to see the full gallery.

process.title: How we work
process.brief_desc: Tell us about the property: size, address and date. We reply with a quote within 24 hours.
process.session_desc: Viktoria comes on site. An apartment up to 80 m² takes about 1.5–2 hours to photograph.
process.selection_desc: You receive every shot with basic editing and choose the ones for full retouching.
process.delivery_desc: Within 48–72 hours the photos are on Google Drive, in web and high-resolution versions.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: We match the package to the size of the property. All prices are net of VAT.
pricing.minimal_desc: Studios and small apartments for sale or rent.
pricing.optimal_desc: Apartments with plenty of detail that need more shots.
pricing.maximum_desc: Large apartments, houses and commercial units.
pricing.premium_desc: Houses with grounds, developments, facade and drone photography.
pricing.extra2: Advanced retouching: recolouring furniture, removing or adding objects
pricing.agency_desc: For regular bookings we agree terms individually: price per property, session dates and invoicing.
pricing.designer_desc: A full shooting day for your portfolio. We work without a time limit until the details and the design intent look right. We agree the number of photos together.

studio.title: Studio
studio.p1: Viktoria has been photographing interiors for over five years. She leads every session herself: setting the light, keeping verticals straight and choosing the frames.
studio.p2: A team of retouchers handles post-production and a licensed drone operator takes the aerial shots. That keeps turnaround short and quality the same on every job.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: How long does a session take?
faq.a1: An apartment up to 80 m² usually takes 1.5–2 hours. Larger houses and Designer Day sessions take 3 to 8 hours.
faq.q2: When will I get the finished photos?
faq.a2: Within 48–72 hours after you choose the frames for retouching.
faq.q3: What rights do I get to the photos?
faq.a3: A licence to use the photos to promote and sell the property: on websites, listing portals and social media. Copyright stays with the studio.
faq.a4: Yes. Aerial shots are taken by a licensed operator we work with regularly. We quote them individually or include them in the Premium package.
faq.t1: The number of shots depends on the property. We usually take more photos than the package includes.
faq.t2: All photos are delivered with basic editing. The Client chooses which ones get full retouching.
faq.t3: An extra photo beyond the package costs 20 PLN.
faq.t4: Properties over 150 m² are quoted individually.
faq.t5: Advanced retouching (recolouring furniture, removing or adding objects) costs 40 PLN per photo.
faq.t6: We shoot on professional equipment and edit in licensed software (HDR, colour correction, retouching).
faq.t7: Photos are shared on Google Drive in two versions: for the web and in high resolution.
faq.t8: All prices are net of VAT.

contact.title: Tell us about the property.
contact.subtitle: Write what needs photographing and when. We reply within 24 hours.
contact.field_message_ph: E.g. 60 m² rental apartment in Mokotów, ideally next week
contact.rodo: I agree to the processing of my personal data to answer this enquiry (GDPR).
contact.sent: We opened your email app with the message ready. Send it and we will reply within 24 hours.
